card.name: Sarcastic punctuation in web rants
card.fires_on: Exclamation marks, dashes, colons and linking words like 'and' or 'while' in sarcastic or ranting opinion text. It sits at the point where the writer pivots to a mocking or ironic follow-up.

modes.label: Exclamation after a rant clause
modes.description: An exclamation mark ending a mocking, conspiratorial claim, just before the next jab.
modes.example: genetic engineered crops make you into a slave of the NWO<<!>> And they give you cancers and stop you

modes.label: Linking word before an ironic turn
modes.description: A conjunction or dash that introduces a sarcastic contrast or add-on.
modes.example: towards the enemy's cannons,<< while>> their own cannons mercilessly slaughtered the opposing

modes.label: Colon or dash before a quip
modes.description: A colon or dash that introduces a quoted or ironic statement in political commentary.
modes.example: Louie Gohmert<<:>> Women should be forced to carry nonv

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly suppresses casual slang adjectives like 'funky', 'nasty' and 'creepy'.
card.plain: It fires on punctuation and joining words in snarky blog-style writing, where the author is about to make a sarcastic point.
